# Spark Connector - (current)

> Integrate MongoDB with Apache Spark using the MongoDB Connector for Spark, supporting Spark Structured Streaming.

- [API Documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/api-docs.md): Explore API documentation for the Spark Connector.
- [Batch Mode](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/batch-mode.md): Explore how to use the Spark Connector to read and write data to MongoDB in batch mode using Spark's Dataset and DataFrame APIs.
- [Batch Read Configuration Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/batch-mode/batch-read-config.md): Configure batch read options for the Spark Connector, including connection URI, database, collection, and partitioner settings for efficient data processing.
- [Read from MongoDB in Batch Mode](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/batch-mode/batch-read.md): Learn how to read data from MongoDB in batch mode by using Spark, including configuration settings, schema inference, and applying filters.
- [Batch Write Configuration Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/batch-mode/batch-write-config.md): Configure batch write operations to MongoDB using various properties like connection URI, database, collection, and write concern options.
- [Write to MongoDB in Batch Mode](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/batch-mode/batch-write.md): Learn how to write data to MongoDB in batch mode using the Spark Connector, specifying format and configuration settings for Java, Python, and Scala.
- [Configuring Spark](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/configuration.md): Configure read and write operations in Spark using `SparkConf`, options maps, or system properties for batch and streaming modes.
- [FAQ](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/faq.md): Find solutions for data locality, pipeline stage errors, mTLS authentication, and sharing a MongoClient instance across threads with the Spark Connector.
- [Getting Started with the Spark Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/getting-started.md): Get started with the Spark Connector by setting up dependencies, configuring connections, and integrating with platforms like Amazon EMR and Databricks.
- [MongoDB Connector for Spark](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/index.md): Integrate MongoDB with Apache Spark using the MongoDB Connector for Spark, supporting Spark Structured Streaming.
- [Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/release-notes.md): Explore the latest features and changes in the MongoDB Connector for Spark, including updates for Java Sync Driver and support for multiple Spark versions.
- [Streaming Mode](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/streaming-mode.md): Explore how to use the Spark Connector for reading and writing data in streaming mode with Spark Structured Streaming.
- [Streaming Read Configuration Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/streaming-mode/streaming-read-config.md): Configure streaming read options for MongoDB in Spark, including connection settings, parsing strategies, and change stream configurations.
- [Read from MongoDB in Streaming Mode](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/streaming-mode/streaming-read.md): Learn to read data from MongoDB in streaming mode using the Spark Connector, supporting micro-batch and continuous processing with configuration options.
- [Streaming Write Configuration Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/streaming-mode/streaming-write-config.md): Configure properties for writing data to MongoDB in streaming mode, including connection URI, database, collection, and checkpoint settings.
- [Write to MongoDB in Streaming Mode](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/streaming-mode/streaming-write.md): Learn to write data to MongoDB in streaming mode using Spark Connector with configuration settings for Java, Python, and Scala.
- [Configure TLS/SSL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/tls.md): Learn how to configure TLS/SSL for secure communication between the Spark Connector and MongoDB, including setting up JVM trust and key stores.
